onscreen_text_en: How does KYC work, and who should get your ID?

scenes.visual_en: Nexubo closes the private chat with a ding (antenna red, chip 'Never send ID in chat'); camera zooms to the official domain and the official verification entry, antenna turns blue.

lines.speaker: nexubo
lines.text: Identity checks are usually there to confirm you are the account owner and to meet the rules. Make sure it's the official flow first. Don't hand your ID or codes to an 'agent' in a chat group.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 身份认证通常用来核实账户本人、满足合规要求。先确认是官方流程，不要把证件、验证码交给聊天群里的代办。

Identity checks are usually there to confirm you are the account owner and to meet the rules. Make sure it's the official flow first. Don't hand your ID or codes to an 'agent' in a chat group.

scenes.visual_en: Mock flow: real residence and name → valid ID → photo as instructed. Every ID shown is an obviously fictional sample marked SAMPLE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Usually you enter your real details, upload a supported valid ID, then follow the prompts for a photo or face check. Whether you need proof of address, and which IDs are accepted, depends on your region and platform.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 一般先填真实信息，再提交支持的有效证件，按提示完成照片或本人验证。是否需要地址证明、接受什么证件，都取决于地区和平台。

scenes.visual_en: Three failed samples (glare, cropped, expired) each get a red X, then morph into a clear, complete, valid example with a green check.

lines.speaker: nexubo
lines.text: If it fails, read the reason first. Is the ID expired? Is there glare? Does the name match? Fix it as instructed. Never try again with a fake identity.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 失败时先看原因：证件是否过期、画面是否反光、姓名是否一致。按提示补正，不要换一个虚假的身份去尝试。

title.zh-Hans: 转账之前，这几项一个也别猜

scenes.visual_en: Sam sees only the lower fee and goes to switch networks. Nexubo's antenna snaps red with a short 'ding'; a red chip pops up: 'Network must match'.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: This network is cheaper. Why not just switch?
lines.text_zh_Hans: 这个网络更便宜，随便换它不就好了？

scenes.visual_en: A sender card and a receiver card; coin and network lines connect and must match on both ends.

lines.speaker: nexubo
lines.text: First confirm which asset and network the receiver supports. Then think about fees. If the two ends don't match, don't send just because it's cheaper. Even USDT can live on different networks.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 先确认收款方支持哪种资产和网络，再选择费用。两端不匹配，不能因为便宜就发送。同叫泰达币，也可能在不同网络上。

scenes.visual_en: Mail analogy: network = route, address = destination. A big label says 'Analogy only'.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: For now, think of the network as the route and the address as the destination. But two addresses can look alike and still not work on the same network. Always check that the receiving platform supports this chain and this asset.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 你可以暂时把网络想成路线，把地址想成目的地，但地址看起来一样，也不代表网络兼容。必须查看接收平台对这条链和这项资产的支持。

scenes.visual_en: Full checklist lights up item by item: coin, network, full address, Memo/Tag if required, minimum deposit, estimated arrival.

lines.speaker: nexubo
lines.text: Copy the address from the receiving page, then check all of it. If a memo or tag is required, fill it in. Confirm the minimum deposit, the withdrawal fee and the amount that will arrive. Don't judge an address by its first and last few characters.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 从收款页面复制地址，再核对完整内容。若要求备注或标签，也要填写。确认最低充值、提币费用和到账金额；不要只靠地址前后几个字符判断。

title.en: Isolated margin: putting one trade in its own box
title.zh-Hans: 逐仓：把这笔交易装进独立小盒子

scenes.visual_en: On the desk: a small box holding 100 and a remaining balance of 900. Sam tapes a divider between them.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: If I put 100 in isolated, the other 900 can never be touched?
lines.text_zh_Hans: 放一百做逐仓，另外九百就永远碰不到了？
command: a friendly adult American man new to crypto, natural and conversational, clear diction, curious but not cartoonish
If I put 100 in isolated, the other 900 can never be touched?

scenes.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E21' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
onscreen_text_en: Isolated margin: putting one trade in its own box

scenes.visual_en: Nexubo keeps the divider but peels off the word 'forever'; the box is labelled with a specific position.

lines.speaker: nexubo
lines.text: Isolated margin means a position gets its own margin. In a simple setup, with no adding and no auto-add, this position's liquidation risk is mainly carried by the margin you assigned.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 逐仓的核心，是给仓位单独分配保证金。在不追加、不启用自动追加等简化条件下，这个仓位的强平风险主要由分配的保证金承担。
command: Your KYC got rejected again? Don't worry. Most rejections come down to just a few simple mistakes. Let's fix them together.
Isolated margin means a position gets its own margin. In a simple setup, with no adding and no auto-add, this position's liquidation risk is mainly carried by the margin you assigned.

scenes.visual_en: A loss only lowers the box's equity; the other balance doesn't automatically become this position's margin.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So it helps you separate the margin of different positions. But that 100 can still be lost. Isolated margin doesn't make losses disappear, and it isn't a stop-loss order.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 所以它便于区分不同仓位的保证金范围。但这一百本身仍可能损失，逐仓不是让亏损消失，也不是止损订单。

So it helps you separate the margin of different positions. But that 100 can still be lost. Isolated margin doesn't make losses disappear, and it isn't a stop-loss order.

scenes.visual_en: An 'Auto-add margin' toggle switches on; a pipe carries extra balance into the box; the total money-at-risk number rises. Antenna red with a ding, red chip 'Auto-add moves more money in'.

lines.speaker: nexubo
lines.text: Watch this switch. Some platforms offer auto-add margin. Turn it on, and your available balance can keep flowing into the position. Adding margin by hand does the same. More money ends up carrying the risk.
lines.text_zh_Hans: 注意这个开关：有的平台提供自动追加保证金。打开后，可用余额可能继续流入仓位。手动追加也一样，会让更多资金参与承担风险。

scenes.visual_en: Sam checks four items: margin mode, auto-add switch, how fees are deducted, total amount committed. Not judging by button colour.
